high_level_description: The image shows two women standing outdoors on a set of stone steps in front of a building with a stone facade and green shutters. The woman on the left is wearing a bright blue suit with a matching blazer and pants. She has short, light-colored hair and is smiling warmly at the camera. The woman on the right is dressed in a white lace top and matching white pants, paired with open-toed sandals. She also has shoulder-length dark hair and is smiling broadly. The setting appears to be a formal or semi-formal event, given the attire of both women.
